title: coreopsis diversifolia
intro: Coreopsis diversifolia, commonly known as Pink Coreopsis or Coreopsis, is a perennial plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis diversifolia include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
